resources.string: Hold your phone at eye level in a well-lit place. Keep your face inside the circle and follow the on-screen prompts.
Hold your phone at eye level in a well-lit place. Keep your face inside the circle while setup completes.
Keep in mind
Glasses may affect recognition. Enroll with the look you use most.
Someone who looks like you may be able to unlock your phone.
Face Unlock may unlock your phone when you look at it, even if you did not intend to.
Face Unlock is less secure than a strong pattern, PIN, or password.
How it works
Face Unlock uses the front camera to recognize your face.
You\'re in control
You can remove your face data or turn off Face Unlock at any time in Settings.
Use this setup if you cannot complete the standard enrollment movements.
Use this setup if you need an alternative to the standard visual guidance.
Use an alternative enrollment flow if standard head movements or visual guidance are difficult to complete.
Glasses may affect recognition. Help your child enroll with the look they use most.
Someone who looks like your child may be able to unlock this phone.
Face Unlock may unlock the phone when your child looks at it, even if they did not intend to.
Face Unlock is less secure than your child using a strong pattern, PIN, or password.
Face Unlock uses the front camera to recognize your child\'s face.
You\'re in control
You can remove your child\'s face data or turn off Face Unlock at any time in Settings.
